If you want to make sure ONLY members of production can see a message, you should use your submissions channel instead. That channel will also be used for challenge submissions. Dear Ace, I'm so proud of you and what you've achieved this game. I can't believe I ever thought less of you. You've come so far since when I watched you play SmORGon--you would have won this season. You played such an amazing game, and I'm sorry our games couldn't coexist. I'm sorry that your game would come at the expense of mine had I gone to FTC with you. I'm sorry for not being strong enough to fight alongside you at the end. I knew I didn't stand a chance. I knew you would have floored me, if not by the game you've played, but the way you would have presented that to the Jury. I want you to win one day. My goal for this game wasn't to see you win, my goal is and always was to win myself. I would have been happy if you beat me, though, I would have felt okay with it. I just wanted a fighting chance at the very least. I didn't want to feel like I was surrendering just to let you win. That's not fair to either of us. Of course you would have won regardless, but it felt like I'd be giving up just by letting you go to FTC. Even now, I'm struggling so much to keep up with Dorm and Ebb. I'm not as strong as those two. My words don't come off the way I want them to. You taught me how to be confident all those years ago. I'm not sure if you remember all that--I barely do myself. Every year, I forget what happens, my memory is so unbelievably bad, but I still remember the impact you had on me. I remember when you were so stuck up, so annoyingly full of yourself, but still so charming. You told me that people believe what you tell them. If you tell someone you're attractive, they'll start to believe you. I never thought of it that way. I was such a self-deprecating teen, I don't know how anyone even wanted to hang out with me. But you still did. Somewhere down the line, I started doing what you do. Talk about how pretty I am, how cool, talented, and fun I am. Even if I didn't believe it, I kept saying it aloud. Eventually, I did start to believe it. To this day, I still struggle with truly liking my personality, that's something that I need to work on. However, I actually, really like my appearance now. I feel like it's the opposite with a lot of people, it was for me back then, but now...I can look at myself in the mirror and. Smile. I love taking photos, even if I'm not the best at posing. I love dressing up, even if it's a little much at times. Even when I feel ugly, even when my acne tries to nerf me SO BAD oh my GOD why is it STILL HERE HOLY SHIT (it's actually like okay right now but still bruh every time i'm on my period it gets worse like why do i have acne in the big 2025 gang get rid of ts)-- anyways, even with bad hair days, messy eyebrows, unshaved legs, I still look, and feel, beautiful. That's insane. It was one small comment you made that changed my whole worldview.
5:51 PM
I remember this other time when I shared my struggles with my physical health. How hard it was to gain weight, how weak I was and struggled with strength exercises, how helpless I felt because of it all. I remember my CAS project in highschool where I needed activity hours, I would try to do planks as long as I could. We were on a call, and you said that watching the timer makes it a lot harder, and that you would keep time for me. You'd encourage me, tell me how I was almost at 1 minute, told me not to give up--you lied to me and made me plank for two whole minutes. That was insane. No wonder that minute felt like forever--it wasn't even a minute!! There have been so many little things that have impacted me so much. You were there in 2024 when I was struggling with love, when I felt alone in my friend groups that consisted of couples, when I felt like I wasn't as important to them because I wasn't as smart. I felt so isolated. It was always a negative cycle like that with me, even back in highschool, where I'd leave a ton of servers when sad, push people away, and then wonder why I felt so horribly depressed. I haven't done that since, my birthday maybe? Back in February? I don't know what I'll do for my birthday next year, it's always been a time where I feel so alone, but I don't think I'll act as closed off as I've done in the past. I don't know. But, thank you, for being there for me. Thank you for offering me a place to talk when I needed it. Thank you for trusting me to hold some of your struggles as well. Thank you for inviting me to play this season, I had so much fun, and remembered what it felt like when I played SmORGon. You helped me heal my perception of ORGs. You showed me how it's not the cast, but rather me, who has the ability to make the game fun. Thank you for wanting to go to the end with me, even if I wasn't strong enough to want the same. Thank you for defending me when people have said bad things about me. Even if we don't talk every day, thank you for being my friend all this time. Thank you for everything, ace.
